summary.headline: Deepak Nitrite Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue hit record INR 3,091 crore (+61% YoY) and EBITDA INR 643 crore (21% margin), led by Phenolics.
summary.overview: Management reported record quarterly and half-yearly revenue and EBITDA, driven by Phenolics, which posted its highest-ever revenue and EBIT. Advanced Intermediates (AI) EBIT fell sequentially to INR 49 crore (6% margin) as Q1 demand was under-served and customers imported nitroaromatics and sodium nitrite in July. Management guided Q3 AI EBIT margin near Q1 levels, with Q4 better, and said new AI assets should lift steady-state AI margins to about 14-15% next year. Capex for H2 FY27 was guided at INR 800-900 crore, with polycarbonate-linked spend continuing through FY29-FY30.

segments.name: Phenolics
segments.commentary: Record Q2 revenue of INR 2,291 crore and EBIT of INR 515 crore (~22% margin), driven by high utilisation, favourable domestic realisations and procurement efficiencies. Management said Q2 ran below the ~4 lakh tonne asset capability, with propylene shortages met via costlier non-traditional sources.

segments.name: Advanced Intermediates
segments.commentary: Q2 revenue INR 811 crore, EBIT INR 49 crore (~6%), down from INR 67 crore in Q1 on input cost pressure, lower utilisation after July imports, duties, logistics and freight. Management says AI headwinds are Phenolics tailwinds under the integrated model.

guidance_outlook: Q3 FY27 AI EBIT margin expected between Q1 and Q2 levels, closer to Q1; Q4 AI EBIT margin expected above Q3.

Management sees AI EBIT adding about INR 240 crore this year from full utilisation of new assets, and about INR 400-420 crore next year; cited steady-state visibility of INR 250 crore plus another INR 250 crore.
Next year's steady-state AI EBIT margin targeted at about 14-15%; FY28 expected to look like a normalised year.
H2 FY27 capex guided at INR 800-900 crore, with bank funding now starting as equity commitments are largely met (about INR 50 crore equity left).
Total capex guided at about INR 11,700 crore across the programme: INR 2,200-2,400 crore next year, INR 2,500 crore in FY29, and INR 2,500-3,000 crore in the final year.
Polycarbonate resin plant remains on FY29 timeline; integrated propylene-to-polycarbonate asset linked to PDH feedstock is FY30; full optimised utilisation of polycarbonate expected by FY31.
capex_capacity: Deepak Chemtech commissioned chlorination at Dahej towards end of Q2, adding to photohalogenation and specialty chemicals plant; capex about INR 300 crore including utilities and infra.
Nitric acid facility under ramp-up; nitration, hydrogenation and fluorination assets commissioned; upstream integrated assets showed over 100% utilisation from September.
MIBK/MIBC plant running at about 60% utilisation, with management targeting 100%+; REACH registrations obtained in Deepak's name for MIBK and MIBC after Q2.
Acetophenone commissioned last year; sales started with ramp-up expected in Q3 FY27.

Phenolics capability close to 4 lakh tonnes per year; Q2 said to run below that but not significantly lower. New phenol capacity: about 80-100 KTPA could be merchant-sold from the new integrated asset.
Polycarbonate compounding is a pilot asset; approvals sought in electronics, mobility and defence; resin imports into India exceed about 2 lakh tonnes a year.
demand_pricing: Management said Indian phenol demand is about 6 lakh tonnes, growing 6-7% a year; new capacity would be absorbed by plywood, decorative laminates, chemicals, agrochemicals and automotive.
Q1 AI demand exceeded supply; customers imported nitroaromatics and sodium nitrite in July, and management says most have returned to Deepak.
Management said China does not participate in Indian phenol and sees its role in AI mainly when domestic supply is short; nitroaromatics demand is rising in India, the West and China.
Propylene feedstock was bought at roughly double the normal index price in some cases to secure supply.
Management described the current cycle as buoyant domestic demand plus geopolitical disruption, not a commodity super cycle.
Deepak is now India's largest acetone consumer; captive acetone use (including MIBK, MIBC and IPA) is about 60-65% of production.

qa_highlights.question: What is the outlook for AI EBIT in H2 FY27 and FY28, and which products saw volume gains?
qa_highlights.answer: Management guided Q3 AI EBIT margin near Q1 levels and Q4 better. Nitroaromatics and sodium nitrite drove the July imports; customers are returning and upstream assets ran above 100% from September.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the phenol capacity is running and will it sustain?
qa_highlights.answer: Q2 ran below the ~4 lakh tonne capability but not significantly; winter months and procurement are expected to support Q3 throughput.

qa_highlights.question: Why did polycarbonate timing change to FY30?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the resin plant stays on FY29; the integrated propylene-to-polycarbonate asset, tied to the PDH feedstock plant, is FY30, and resin will initially use bought-out BPA.

qa_highlights.question: What are the AI EBIT targets for FY28-29?
qa_highlights.answer: About INR 240 crore this year and INR 400-420 crore next year from the new assets; steady-state visibility of about INR 250 crore plus another INR 250 crore, with AI margin of 14-15%.

qa_highlights.question: What is the capex plan?
qa_highlights.answer: About INR 800-900 crore in H2 FY27, then INR 2,200-2,400 crore, INR 2,500 crore and INR 2,500-3,000 crore in the following years; total about INR 11,700 crore.

qa_highlights.question: Is there Chinese competition in phenol or AI?
qa_highlights.answer: No Chinese participation in phenol; China participates in AI mainly when domestic supply falls short. Anti-involution steps are seen as supportive for Indian players.

risks_watch: Phenol import competition from new capacity may pressure spreads and acetone prices in the short to medium term.
Propylene availability and cost; Q2 relied on non-traditional, higher-priced sources.
AI segment margin recovery depends on new asset utilisation and customer contracts, still being finalised; two further investments pending customer locks.
Polycarbonate timeline: integrated asset FY30 and compounding approvals in electronics, mobility and defence still in progress.
Management declined to share Phenolics volumes and phenol/acetone price levels, limiting visibility on spreads.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on Phenolics and the AI recovery, with specific multi-year EBIT targets. More guarded on near-term price volatility and declined to disclose phenolic volumes and phenol/acetone pricing.
